يتراضيا (form VI)
# يَتَرَاضَيَا (yatarāḍayā) /ja.ta.raː.dˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
# يُتَرَاضَيَا (yutarāḍayā) /ju.ta.raː.dˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
